description: Lists contacts in the tenant CRM — a person in the tenant CRM. Cursor-paginated: limit 1-100, opaque cursor from the previous page. Filters: q, company_id. Needs crm:read on the organization. Every item carries an absolute url. Being in the CRM is not permission to email: consent lives in the `marketing` sub-resource.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page
